declaration.economic_scope: row-scan units and hypothetical expensive-oracle conversions are reported separately from measured small-dataset wall time
declaration.greedy_comparator: every proposal passing the free prefilter is accepted without a certificate; its cost and violations are computed only in the post-decision audit and carry no robust guarantee
declaration.marginal_comparator: the sharp independent-marginal certificate for the same H=6 envelope rejects at value one
declaration.membership: all accepted proposal, residual, distance, row-norm, and class bounds are recomputed from stored binary64 inputs with exact fractions.Fraction arithmetic
declaration.proposal: 10% sampled diagonal-Hessian reduced-Newton step, safeguarded by a 0.009 correction around the gradient center
declaration.role: real-data external benchmark for a short-transcript decision; not a clinical claim or a production deployment
